5\. Other alarms delay owner reminders 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
cmd_watchdog() passes the waiting request's timestamp to stall_alarm() without restricting it to
alarms about that request. If state was unreadable after the request and its alarm was posted before
state recovered, the unreadable alarm counts as the waiting reminder and postpones the first
reminder until its own 12-hour interval expires.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description An alarm for another condition can suppress the first reminder for an unanswered owner request. ## Fix Focus Areas - room.py[2956-2964] - room.py[3166-3170] ## Recommended Fix Select only waiting-for-Matthew alarms for the particular request when calculating its retries and reminder interval. Add a test with an intervening state-unreadable alarm. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
